name: @escalier/cli-win32-arm64
description: The escalier compiler binary for Windows on ARM64. Install @escalier/cli instead of depending on this package.
author: escalier-lang

scripts.prepublishOnly: node -e "if (!require('fs').existsSync('bin/escalier.exe')) { console.error('bin/escalier.exe is missing. Build the platform binaries before publishing.'); process.exit(1); }"
